# 谢宝新 · Xie Baoxin

Canonical page: https://xiebaoxin.github.io/resume/

谢宝新（Xie Baoxin）的公开简历。默认中文：https://xiebaoxin.github.io/resume/index.html 。英文：https://xiebaoxin.github.io/resume/index.html#en 。

## Identity
- Name: 谢宝新 / Xie Baoxin
- Gender and age are not printed on the public resume.
- Location: 深圳 / Shenzhen · 接受新西兰、澳大利亚及海外远程（欢迎担保） / open to New Zealand, Australia, and remote overseas (sponsorship welcome)
- Experience label printed on the resume: 12年 / 12 years
- Target role: 求职意向：工程管理 / 软件研发负责人 · AI 辅助产品与 ERP 交付（新西兰、澳大利亚、海外远程）
- English target: Engineering Manager / Head of Software · AI-assisted product & ERP delivery (open to NZ, AU, remote overseas)

## Summary
现任深圳安嘉科技有限公司软件研发部总监（2026.04 — 至今）。主导 AnjiaERP（AJERP）功能设计规格（FDS）与 AI 编程智能体交付（Cursor、Claude Code、云端编程智能体、skills/rules、MCP），并负责 SightSys（https://www.sightsyscloud.com/）：App 架构重构，后台由 Python 迁至 Go，3 个月从零搭建云智控后台；安防摄像机已上架 Alexa 与 Google Home。此前 Flutter 跨端与 IoT / 电商全链路可交付，含面向海外市场的 Hipobuy。

Director of Software R&D at Shenzhen Anjia Technology Co., Ltd. since Apr 2026. Leads AnjiaERP (AJERP) functional design specifications (FDS) and AI-agent delivery (Cursor, Claude Code, cloud agents, skills/rules, MCP), and SightSys (https://www.sightsyscloud.com/): app architecture refactor, backend moved from Python to Go, cloud control console built from scratch in 3 months. Security cameras listed on Alexa and Google Home. Earlier Flutter, IoT, and e-commerce delivery remains on the resume, including Hipobuy for overseas markets. FDS means functional design specifications for AnjiaERP.

## Current role (main resume)

- Company: 深圳安嘉科技有限公司 / Shenzhen Anjia Technology Co., Ltd.
- Period: 2026.04 — 至今 / Apr 2026 — Present
- Role: 软件研发部总监 / Director of Software R&D
- Site: https://www.sightsyscloud.com/
- SightSys App: 完成 App 架构重构。 Completed the app architecture refactor.
- Backend APIs: 完成后台接口由 Python 到 Go 的系统重构。 Refactored the backend from Python to Go.
- SightSys 云智控 / SightSys Cloud Control: 从无到有，3 个月完成云智控后台的搭建与部署。 Built and deployed the cloud control console from scratch in 3 months.
- AnjiaERP (AJERP) FDS: 负责制造型 ERP 的功能设计规格（FDS）：产品与 BOM 数据中心、报价到销售订单、席位权限；并用 AI 编程智能体、自建 skills/rules 与 MCP 推动实现。 Owns functional design specifications (FDS) for the manufacturing ERP: product and BOM data center, quote-to-sales-order flow, and seat permissions. Drives the build with AI coding agents, custom skills/rules, and MCP.
- AI-assisted delivery: 日常使用 Cursor、Claude Code 与云端编程智能体做实现与验收；把产品锁定要求写成 skills 与 rules，由智能体协同交付，而不是只靠手写每一行代码。 Uses Cursor, Claude Code, and cloud coding agents for implementation and acceptance. Encodes hard product locks as skills and rules, and orchestrates delivery with agents rather than hand-only coding.
- Security cameras: 完成上架 Alexa 与 Google Home。 Completed listing on Alexa and Google Home.
- GCP: 搭建 Skill，用于 GCP 运营。 Built skills for GCP operations.
- Practice, as stated: 负责 AnjiaERP 功能设计规格（FDS），并以 Cursor、Claude Code、云端编程智能体、skills/rules 与 MCP 推进交付；熟悉 WebRTC。 Owns AnjiaERP functional design (FDS) and AI-agent delivery with Cursor, Claude Code, cloud agents, skills/rules, and MCP. Familiar with WebRTC. FDS means functional design specifications for AnjiaERP.
